description.narrative: (Nigeria): Monkeypox (Mpox) is endemic in Nigeria and has seen a surge in the number of cases with the most recent re-emergence in line with the current global outbreak of the virus notably among key populations. Support is provided to the risk communication and animal health pillars of the government of Nigeria's response to the ongoing outbreak as well as the mpox vaccine. USAID will leverage existing platforms and programming in priority states to deploy the vaccine among highest risk populations.
